en.headline: Police identify 60-year-old driver in Central BMW illegal left turn
en.dek: Island District traffic investigators have located the local male driver of a dual-plate BMW filmed reversing near Pedder Street after an illegal turn on 23 October.
body: Police said they have identified a 60-year-old local male driver of a dual-plate BMW private car that made an illegal left turn and then reversed at the junction of Pedder Street and Des Voeux Road Central on the evening of 23 October.

According to the Island District Traffic Investigation Team, the vehicle was travelling north on Pedder Street at about 7pm when it turned left into Des Voeux Road Central against the ahead-only road markings. The driver then reversed several times amid traffic and pedestrians before returning to Pedder Street.

Officers said the manoeuvre seriously affected pedestrian safety. After reviewing footage, they located the vehicle and driver on 5 November. The case is being handled as careless driving, and police intend to prosecute the driver. No arrest has been made.
Police reminded drivers to observe road signs and plan routes in advance. Careless driving carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5,000 fine and six months' imprisonment.

zh.headline: 中環寶馬違例左轉 警鎖定60歲本地男司機
zh.dek: 港島總區交通調查組已鎖定10月23日在畢打街違例左轉後倒車的兩地牌寶馬本地男司機，案件列作不小心駕駛跟進。
body: 警方表示，已鎖定一輛兩地牌寶馬私家車的60歲本地男司機。該車於10月23日晚上約7時在中環畢打街及德輔道中交界違例左轉後，多次倒車調整位置。
港島總區交通調查組指，車輛當時沿畢打街北行，違反只許向前駛的道路標記左轉進入德輔道中。司機其後在行人及車流間倒車，待空隙後才返回畢打街繼續行駛。
警方指事件嚴重影響行人安全。經翻查片段，調查人員於11月5日鎖定涉案車輛及司機，案件暫列不小心駕駛，將依法檢控，暫時未有人被捕。
警方提醒駕駛者應留意路牌及預早計劃路線。不小心駕駛最高可被判罰款5,000元及監禁六個月。
